item.title: A Visit to Kyiv to Mark Ukraine's 35 Years of Independence
item.description: On this anniversary, the Ukrainian people's steadfast hope and determination continue to inspire.

item.title: Milo Yiannopoulos deported to U.K. after ICE detention at Louisiana airport
item.description: Right-wing provocateur Milo Yiannopoulos was deported to the U.K., a day after being detained by ICE at a New Orleans-area airport.

item.title: Seeing Italy for the First Time
item.description: Italy is as scenic as advertised, but reaching all the sights is an adventure.

item.title: Ned's Club near White House now feels overcrowded
item.description: Ned's Club, a members-only club near the White House, was popular when it opened last year, but some members are disappointed by a loss of luxury.
